A direct viewer.bookings.addGuests mutation with ["a@x.com","a@x.com"] passes the handler and reaches prisma createMany on line 101, persisting two identical attendee rows (or aborting on the bookingId+email unique constraint with an unhandled INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR instead of the promised BAD_REQUEST emails_must_be_unique_valid) and emailing the address twice.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` only filters out emails already in `booking.attendees` and those in `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS` (via `guests.filter(...)`), but it does not dedupe duplicates within the incoming `guests` array. The server input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` (`addGuests.schema.ts`) also lacks a uniqueness refinement (it only validates `.email()`). Therefore a direct `viewer.bookings.addGuests` call with duplicate emails (e.g. `["a@x.com","a@x.com"]`) will pass server validation and flow into `createMany` with duplicate rows. This can lead to duplicate attendee records and/or a DB constraint error, and it can also result in duplicate emails because `sendAddGuestsEmails` iterates over `calendarEvent.attendees` and would send per attendee entry.
